name: Grease and sealant fittings
function: The check-valved fittings on the body and bonnet through which sealant is injected into the seat pockets and body cavity, and the bleed port through which trapped cavity pressure is released.

tabs.overview: Sealant injected behind the seats supports the metal seal after wear and displaces proppant from the cavity. Fittings carry a check valve; the body bleed is a small valve or plug used to verify zero cavity pressure before the bonnet is opened.
tabs.engineering: Fittings rated to the valve working pressure; sealant per the OEM.
tabs.safety: Grease fittings are high-pressure connections; a fitting with a failed check will discharge when the cap is removed. Bleed the cavity through the bleed port, never by loosening a fitting.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
